correctness.rationale: Parity-class conservation gives an equal number of even-even and odd-odd length-two edges, forcing b even. When 3|n the n−1 length-three edges remain within even-sized mod-three classes, while the unique length-one edge leaves two odd residual classes, excluding the stated profile. For b=2t>0, the six explicit disjoint-endpoint tiles A=(1,0,0), B=(1,0,1), C=(0,2,0), D=(0,0,3), E=(0,2,1), F=(0,2,2) concatenate to give all residue classes of c modulo 3 with t≥1. For b=0, r copies of B and q of D plus a−r of A handle a≥r where c=3q+r; remaining a=0 and 3∤n cases admit the step-three Hamiltonian matching because gcd(3,2n)=1. The sole a=1,r=2 remainder is exactly the excluded 3|n case. The n=3 diameter-three boundary is covered. An independent exhaustive matching-mask recurrence checked n=3,...,8 and produced [5,9,12,15,20,25] admissible histograms, not the proof of all n.

value.rationale: Solves the first nontrivial full three-distance region of a concrete published seating-couples question, including the odd-prime three-length conjectural case and the sharp new composite-order obstruction. Explicit six-tile concatenations yield an algorithm for every allowable multiplicity triple, not a small isolated numeric instance.

final_claim: For every n≥3, a perfect matching on 2n labeled cyclic seats with exactly a edges of circular length 1, b length 2, c length 3 exists iff b is even and not (3|n, a=1, b=0, c=n−1), with a+b+c=n; constructive for every admissible triple.
limitations: No count of how many matchings realize each profile, and no extension to lengths four or greater.
One exact excluded profile only when n divisible by three and b=0.
